summary: Frontend tests at mobile size 375x667 for the four new features, plus regression checks. All requested UI flows PASS. 1) Drive pins (admin): the Pinned section (drive-pinned-section) shows Armi Myers at the top. There are 19 pin buttons at 44x44. Pinning Avinasha adds it to Pinned with the toast 'Pinned to the top of Company Drive'. Tapping again unpins it with the toast 'Unpinned'. Tapping the nested pin does NOT open the file (no popup). Searching 'Courtney' hides the Pinned section and shows 1 result; clearing restores the section and all 18 files. Unpinning the last pin hides the section. 2) Employee: sees the Pinned section and can open the pinned file (popup opens). There are 0 pin buttons. API POST and DELETE on /drive/pins return 403 for the employee. 3) Integrations > Claude AI card: ai-drive-index-status shows '14 documents readable · checked 2m'. 'Refresh now' shows the toast 'Refreshing Drive documents' and the status updates to 'checked now'. 'Email me a preview' shows the toast 'Preview built (2 channels) but no email sent to admin.test@example.com' after about 4s, as expected for @example.com. 4) Certificates upload: 'Take a photo' (343x73) is shown above Choose file / From photos. On web it opens a file chooser with capture=camera and accept=image/*. After a generated certificate JPG is picked, AI auto-fill starts automatically (spinner) and fills all 4 fields correctly: 'Provide First Aid (HLTAID011)', 'St John Ambulance Australia', 2025-03-10 and 2028-03-10. No certificate was submitted. 5) Regression: Ask AI streams answers and uses Drive docs (it quoted the Armi Myers timesheet date range). Chat Summarise on #Allied Health works and the close button works. Drive browse and search work. CLEANUP DONE: all pins deleted, shared folder cleared (GET /drive/shared returns 409), Drive still connected, and Google Chat links untouched. Two issues were found: drive_docs are left behind after the shared folder is cleared, and Ask AI retrieval is too narrow for 'all docs' questions. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) were found.

critical.issue: This does not purge db.drive_docs, and drive_context() (server.py:1284) does not filter by the current root_id. After the folder was cleared, index-status still reported 14 docs. Ask AI (admin) still listed the timesheets of Armi Myers and Samantha Nugent from the cleared folder. These are real staff pay records. They would stay readable to the AI until the next 4-hourly index_drive run, and POST /drive/reindex returns 409 once the folder is cleared, so an admin cannot force a purge. Changing to a new folder also mixes in old docs until indexing finishes. The tester purged drive_docs manually with Mongo as part of cleanup.

minor.issue: Retrieval returns only about 3 whole docs: each doc is capped at 15k chars against a 50k budget, and it stops at the first zero-score doc. For 'List the staff whose timesheets are in the Company Drive folder', Claude named only 2 of 14 indexed docs and said 'I only see the most relevant files'. Scoring uses exact word counts, so the plural 'timesheets' gets no name-match against filenames containing 'Timesheet'. This only partly meets 'reads all docs in the folder'. Suggestions: always include a list of all indexed file names, use stemming or prefix matching, and use chunk-level retrieval instead of whole docs.

Claude refuses to share another employee's timesheet with an employee ('another employee's pay record'). Yet the same employee can open that exact PDF in Company Drive. The refusal is reasonable, but it shows that the shared folder holding staff timesheets is visible to all employees. Confirm this is intended.

The digest covers every channel and goes to every user, with no per-channel membership filter. If channels are ever restricted to members, private channel content would leak. The meta key is inserted before sending, so a failed run is not retried that week.
Pins are not removed when the folder is cleared. They are filtered by root_id, so they are harmless, but they become orphaned.

ui_bugs.issue: The label 'Reading certificate…' is never visible, because Button with loading=true renders only a spinner (inner text was empty during reading). Users see a blank blue bar while the AI reads. The fields also stay editable during reading, and anything typed is overwritten when the result arrives. Reference: app/upload-certificate.tsx:174-182

There is no in-flight or disabled state, so a quick double-tap sends POST and DELETE races. The same testID drive-pin-<id> appears twice (in the Pinned row and the All files row). Reference: app/drive.tsx:54-63,111

issues: Pinned rows show only 'File' as the meta line, because pins store modified='' and size=null (server.py:955). Show size and updated date like the All files rows, or the pin date.
For admins, the pin icon plus the open icon (44 + 18 px) squeeze file names to 2 truncated lines on 375px screens (for example 'Avinasha Swami-Timesheet-23-2-…').

action_items: HIGH: In clear_shared_folder (and when the folder changes in set_shared_folder), delete db.drive_docs (and drive_pins), or filter drive_context by the current shared_folder_id root_id, so the AI stops serving documents from a removed folder.

MEDIUM: Improve drive_context so the AI can answer questions about the whole folder: always include an index of all doc names, use prefix or stem matching (timesheets vs Timesheet), and use chunked retrieval rather than 15k-char whole docs.
LOW: Show 'Reading certificate…' text alongside the spinner (or a separate reading banner), and disable the fields while auto-fill runs.
LOW: Add a busy state to the pin toggle. Show size/date on pinned rows.
LOW: If channels can be private, filter digest sections by each recipient's channel membership.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:848-879 index_drive: runs drive_text serially per file. That is fine for 18 files, but for large folders (cap 300) the first index will be slow and holds the lock. The index-status 'running' poll handles this.
server.py:1449 send_digest: makes one Claude call per channel per press of 'Email me a preview'. That is a paid call each time; consider caching for a few minutes.

upload-certificate.tsx: only the camera path auto-runs autoFill. Choose file / From photos still need a manual tap. This is consistent with the spec, but auto-running for images from photos too may be expected.

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend only; spot curl checks: pins 403 for employee, bogus file_id returns 404, reindex/digest OK)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested UI flows (2 backend logic issues found)

rca_of_issue: Stale Drive docs: clear_shared_folder only $unsets shared_folder_id. index_drive is the only code that deletes drive_docs when no root exists, and it runs only from drive_index_loop (every 4h) or set_shared_folder/reindex (reindex returns 409 without a root). drive_context queries all drive_docs with no root_id filter. Repro: set the folder, wait for the index, DELETE the shared-folder, then GET /drive/index-status (count stays 14) and ask AI about timesheets (it still answers). Fix: purge in clear_shared_folder and filter by root_id in drive_context.
